title: 第1章 无天

content_zh:
一个小山村隐匿于此，名龙村，村庄很小，十来座木屋组成，占地一里左右，落于山脉，毫不起眼。
村庄后，有一座山峰，高千丈，草木葱茏，古树参天，高耸入云，如一道屏障，挡着徐徐而来的寒风。
黑夜，残月悬空，寒星闪烁。
“火之精，土之精，水之精，木之精，金之精，暗之精，光之精，七元素精元融汇一体，开启无上仙体，激发无尽潜能……”
山巅处，一名少年手捧一张兽皮卷，约十五六岁，身形挺拔，能有七尺，坐在一块庞大的巨石上，聚精会神的看着，脸上尽是向往之色。
少年名无天，是龙村的一员，家中除了步入花甲之年的爷爷外，并无其他亲人，爷孙两相依为命，日子却过得很舒坦。
“持仙体者，可摘星辰，破山河，只手遮天……唉！说是简单，真正要做到却艰难无比，如今我基本体魄都尚未开启，谈何无上仙体……”
无天面红齿白，呼吸间，两道白雾从鼻孔喷出，漆黑的眸子移开兽皮卷，望向天空的残月，呆了片刻，最终一声叹息。
兽皮卷记载，这片大陆名轮回大陆，广袤无垠，大陆分为五大洲，中耀洲，西虎洲，南雀洲，北玄洲，青龙洲，每一洲都辽阔无边，人口密集。
赤阳山脉属青龙洲，青龙洲地理最为广阔，人口何止千万，但能成为俢者却寥寥无几，更别谈只手遮天！
“爷爷曾说过，只要我变强，才能寻到父母，可我如今都已经十六岁，依然没能成为俢者，难道这一生都无缘见到他们！”
突然，无天双目微闭，凌乱的黑发随风而动，双手靠在膝盖上，掐着复杂的手印。
算命之术！
无天的爷爷是以算命为生，从小耳目有染，深得真传，可卜他人吉凶祸福，他想通过此术，看到自己未来，查找父母的下落。
掐指片刻，无天额头中一道乳光忽然冲出，眼前出现了一片辽阔的天地，星辰璀璨，月光炽盛，挥洒而下，隐隐间看见了山川河流，花草树木。
天地的尽头，一座雄伟的巨峰若隐若现，在朦胧的月光下，犹如一尊太古凶兽潜伏，让人心惊胆颤。
而巨峰上，则有一座庞大的宫殿，虽然只是模糊的轮廓，但依然能感受到辉煌与气魄，仿若是一座仙宫，震撼人的视觉。
“轰隆隆！”
这时，天空忽然电闪雷鸣，狂风皱起，暴雨倾盆，雷电风雨中，一只巨手，轰然而落，遮天盖地，遮挡一切。
“噗！”

无天的身躯猛然一震，一口血喷出，眼前的画面消失，唯独剩下一片黑暗。
“真如爷爷所说，我的命运无法测算。”无天睁开眼，眸光黯淡，回想起爷爷曾说过的话：“天儿，爷爷虽能算出他人命运，却无法窥透你的人生，每到关键时刻，彷如有一只无形的大手，将你的未来遮掩，看不见一丝光明。”
望着残月，无天心里说不出的烦躁。
那片星空，他感觉很熟悉，仿佛是前世的记忆，或者是梦中的幻境，有些不真实。那巨峰上的宫殿中，无天隐隐感应到了几道莫名的气息，亲切而陌生，仿佛是在呼唤他。
而那巨手，像是生死仇敌般，让他心生恨意，忍不住想要将其撕碎。
“砰！”
突然，一道碰撞声自身后响起，无天一惊之下，背脊冷汗冒出，一时入神，竟忘记身在何处。
此山虽是村庄的狩猎地点，强大的妖兽不多，但危险却时刻存在，一些实力不强，却异常恐怖的妖兽，时常出没。
如毒蛇，毒虫，毒蝎，魔蛛等毒兽，虽修为不高，但毒性惊人，被咬上一口，不出片刻，便毒液攻心而死。
这样的事情，并不是没发生过。
“噬血虫！”
无天转头，立刻惊呼，面色变化间，身躯陡地跃起，躲在巨石后，毛孔张开，小心戒备。
那是一头只有拳头大般的飞虫，浑身散着血色光芒，两只血翅闪动，发动嗡嗡的声音，嘴上长着一根尖刺，细而长，在昏暗的光线下，宛如一只掠夺者，随时掠夺他人的性命。
它面前，有一头黑豹，能有一米长，模样狰狞，散着凶威。
然而在看向对面的噬血虫时，那双硕大的瞳孔之中，居然透出了丝丝畏惧，庞大的身躯，更是不断微微的颤抖。
两兽对持，无天不敢发声一丝响动，无论是噬血虫，还是黑豹，都是令人胆寒的妖兽，特别是前者，嘴上尖刺异常锋利，可穿金裂石，且速度奇快，如鬼魅般，完全不能防备。

content_en:
A small mountain village is hidden here, named Long Village. The village is very small, consisting of a dozen wooden houses, covering an area of ​​about one mile, and is located in the mountains, making it inconspicuous.
Behind the village, there is a mountain peak, thousands of feet high, with lush vegetation and towering ancient trees, towering into the clouds, like a barrier, blocking the slowly coming cold wind.
In the dark night, the waning moon hangs in the sky and the cold stars twinkle.
"The essence of fire, the essence of earth, the essence of water, the essence of wood, the essence of gold, the essence of darkness, the essence of light, the seven elements are integrated into one, opening the supreme immortal body and stimulating endless potential..."
At the top of the mountain, a young man was holding a scroll of animal skin. He was about fifteen or sixteen years old, tall and tall, about seven feet tall. He was sitting on a huge boulder, looking attentively, with a look of yearning on his face.
The boy named Wutian is a member of Longcun. Apart from his grandfather, who is in his sixties, he has no other relatives in his family. The grandfather and grandson depend on each other, but live a very comfortable life.
"Those who hold the immortal body can pick up stars, break through mountains and rivers, and cover the sky with one hand... Sigh! It sounds simple, but it is extremely difficult to actually achieve it. Now my basic physical body has not yet been opened, so how can I talk about the supreme immortal body..."
Wutian's face was red and his teeth were white. As he breathed, two streams of white mist spurted out from his nostrils. His dark eyes moved away from the animal skin roll and looked at the waning moon in the sky. He stayed for a moment and finally sighed.
The animal skin scroll records that this continent is called Samsara Continent and is vast. The continent is divided into five continents, Zhongyao Continent, Xihu Continent, Nanque Continent, Beixuan Continent, and Qinglong Continent. Each continent is vast and densely populated.
The Chiyang Mountains belong to the Qinglong Continent. The Qinglong Continent is the most vast in geography and has a population of more than 10 million. However, there are very few people who can become you, let alone covering the sky with one hand!
"Grandpa once said that as long as I become stronger, I can find my parents. But now that I am sixteen years old, I still haven't been able to become a guardian. Is it possible that I will never have the chance to see them in this life!"
Suddenly, Wutian's eyes were slightly closed, his messy black hair moving in the wind, his hands resting on his knees, making complicated handprints.
Fortune telling!
Wutian's grandfather makes a living by telling fortunes. He has been interested in fortune-telling since he was a child. He has learned the truth and can predict the good and bad luck of others. He wants to use this technique to see his own future and find out the whereabouts of his parents.
After pinching his fingers for a moment, a ray of milky light suddenly burst out from Wutian's forehead, and a vast sky and earth appeared in front of him. The stars were bright, the moonlight was blazing, and he could vaguely see mountains, rivers, flowers, plants and trees.
At the end of the world, a majestic giant peak looms. Under the dim moonlight, it looks like an ancient ferocious beast lurking, making people tremble with fear.
On the giant peak, there is a huge palace. Although it is only a vague outline, you can still feel the splendor and power. It is like a fairy palace, which is shocking to the eyes.
"Boom!"
At this time, the sky suddenly thundered and lightning flashed, the wind ruffled, and the rain poured down. Amidst the thunder and lightning, a giant hand came down with a crash, covering the sky and the earth, blocking everything.
"Poof!"
Wutian's body suddenly shook, and a mouthful of blood spurted out. The scene in front of him disappeared, leaving only darkness.
"As grandpa said, my destiny is unpredictable." Wutian opened his eyes, his eyes dim, recalling what his grandpa once said: "Tian'er, although grandpa can calculate the fate of others, he can't see into your life. At every critical moment, it's as if there is a big invisible hand covering your future, and you can't see a ray of light."
Looking at the waning moon, Wu Tian felt indescribably irritable.
The starry sky felt very familiar to him, as if it was a memory from a previous life or a fantasy in a dream, somewhat unreal. In the palace on the giant peak, Wutian faintly sensed several inexplicable auras, which were kind and strange, as if they were calling him.
And that giant hand, like a life-and-death enemy, filled him with hatred and couldn't help but want to tear it into pieces.
"Bang!"
Suddenly, a collision sounded behind him. Wutian was startled, and cold sweat broke out on his back. He was so absorbed that he forgot where he was.
Although this mountain is a hunting spot for the village, the powerfulThere are not many monsters, but danger is always there. Some weak but extremely terrifying monsters often appear.
Poisonous beasts such as venomous snakes, poisonous insects, poisonous scorpions, and devil spiders, although their cultivation level is not high, are extremely poisonous. If they are bitten, within a moment, the venom will attack the heart and kill them.
It's not like this has never happened.
"Blood-eating worm!"
Wutian turned his head and immediately exclaimed. As his expression changed, his body suddenly jumped up and hid behind the boulder, his pores opened and he was on guard.
It was a flying insect as big as a fist, with blood-colored light all over its body, two bloody wings flashing, making a buzzing sound, and a sharp thorn on its mouth, which was thin and long. In the dim light, it looked like a predator, ready to plunder the lives of others at any time.
In front of it, there is a black panther, which can be one meter long. It looks ferocious and exudes fierce power.
However, when looking at the blood-devouring insect opposite, there was actually a trace of fear in those huge pupils, and the huge body was constantly trembling slightly.
The two beasts were facing each other, and Wutian didn't dare to make a sound. Whether it was the blood-eating insect or the black panther, they were both terrifying monsters, especially the former. The spikes on its mouth were extremely sharp and could penetrate gold and crack stones. They were also extremely fast, like ghosts, and completely defenseless.
